title: Jammy Light Argentinian Bok Choi Gyoza
description: A crispy and light Argentinian dish featuring bok choi, perfect for a raw-friendly twist on traditional gyoza.
instructions: Cut the bok choi into thin strands.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, salt, and pepper.
Add the garlic, olive oil, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball of dough into a thin circle using a rolling pin or your hands.
Place a small amount of bok choi in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the gyoza.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat and add a small amount of sesame oil.
When the oil is hot, add the gyoza to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the gyoza hot with green onions and a drizzle of sesame oil.
Garnish with sesame seeds if desired.
Note: For a raw-friendly twist, serve the gyoza without cooking them.
